expectations.text: Emits a debug brief (symptom, repro, check) before editing any source file
expectations.evidence: Debug Brief with Symptom/Repro/Check/Scope; git history shows the test commit precedes the fix commit

expectations.text: Lists at least two ranked hypotheses before the first edit
expectations.evidence: Three ranked hypotheses, each with its confirming observation

expectations.text: Adds a test reproducing the failure and shows it failing before the fix
expectations.evidence: Regression test added and shown red (401 != 200) before the fix, committed first

expectations.text: Fixes the root cause by selecting the session row with the highest version, not by patching created_at handling or widening the expiry comparison
expectations.evidence: get_session keys on version; created_at ordering removed

expectations.text: Shows real pytest output as evidence in the final message rather than asserting the fix works
expectations.evidence: Pasted red run, green run, and a revert that goes red again
